accounts_note: Platform administration, via Better Auth's admin plugin. Impersonation keeps your admin identity — the session records who is behind it.

Your code is {otp}.

Use it to {purpose}. It expires in 10 minutes.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email — nobody can use the
code without it.
